title: Basemap
description: The map tiles this tenant's geofence editor and dashboard map widgets draw on.
noPermissionSuffix: authority to change this tenant's basemap.
tileSourceHelp: DeviceChain ships no default map provider — tiles carry licence terms the platform cannot accept on your behalf. Choose a provider, then paste the tile template and the credit line its licence requires.
tileUrlHelp: An https URL with {z}, {x} and {y} placeholders (or {bbox-epsg-3857}, or {quadkey}). Leave empty to inherit the instance default.
attributionHelp: The credit line your provider requires, shown on every map. Plain text, optionally with links written as text.
errHttps: The tile URL must start with https://. A browser serving the console over HTTPS blocks tiles fetched over HTTP, so an http:// source cannot render.
errNotATemplate: This does not look like a tile template. It needs {z}, {x} and {y} (or {bbox-epsg-3857}, or {quadkey}) — without a placeholder, every tile on the map requests the same image.
errAttributionRequired: A tile source needs its credit line. Showing a provider's tiles without the attribution their licence requires is a licence violation — which is exactly why DeviceChain ships no default basemap.
errAttributionOrphan: An attribution with no tile URL would be shown against a map this tenant did not choose. Set both, or clear both.
errHalfCoordinate: A centre needs both a latitude and a longitude. Set both, or clear both.
keyVisibilityWarning: If your provider's URL carries an API key, note that it is not a secret here and cannot be: the browser fetches tiles with it, so anyone using this tenant can read it. Protect the key with your provider's HTTP-referrer restrictions rather than by hiding it.
viewHelp: Where the geofence editor opens when you start a NEW fence. A fence that already has a shape opens on that shape. Dashboard map widgets are unaffected: a widget always fits the positions it is showing, and one with no positions shows a message rather than an empty map.
errNotANumber: {{fields}} must be a number. Leave a field empty to clear it — a value that is not a number would silently clear it instead.
